items.title: Waldren "Frog" Joseph Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: Interviewer mentions 'that's John Bruins, a picket, that's his tune' and Interviewee responds only to the music quality ('That's a good tune'), showing no personal connection or direct interaction.

ctx.x: Yeah, matter of fact, we had a nice little arrangement, you know. One second, let me look up this. Paul Barban record. Did you? This is Bob Thomas was on trombone on this one. Yeah, yeah, yeah. And they didn't play any of your numbers either, I guess. No, no, no. First choice, Scream in the Blues, a couple of things that Paul... First choice, Scream in the Blues, a couple of things that Paul... First choice, that's John Bruins, a picket, that's his tune. Yeah.

And a couple of Paul's, a couple of Paul's, a couple of things that Paul... ...a couple of Paul's, a couple of Paul's, a couple of Paul's, a couple of Paul's. Yeah. Yeah. Alright, I'll take a look up this Paul Barban record.
